purpose: Public identity/role/interface registry for major BL∞ constituents while preserving non-hierarchical typed relations, source lineage and an explicitly non-exhaustive epistemic state space.

profiles.role: distinguish actuality from models, descriptions and finite observed slices
profiles.authority_boundary: formalizes actuality distinction; does not claim any observer model exhausts Reality

profiles.role: formalize assumed/not-yet-established reality states and their dynamic relation with BL∞ and Reality
profiles.authority_boundary: GiaTai may lead generative inference but cannot self-declare actuality
profiles.reality_veto_relation: GiaTai/model status is revisable under qualified evidence

profiles.name_vi: Không gian Pha Nhận thức Mở
profiles.role: represent Reality/GiaTai/mixed/Unknown and other states through an extensible multidimensional phase space
profiles.authority_boundary: current axes and named regions are non-exhaustive projections
profiles.reality_veto_relation: phase labels do not override actuality evidence

profiles.role: detect signatures of missing structure without fabricating unknown content
profiles.authority_boundary: an indicator of missing structure is not knowledge of the missing content

profiles.role: propose, test, retain, merge, dormancy-manage or prune new epistemic dimensions/primitives
profiles.authority_boundary: new dimensions must earn retention; open-ended does not mean infinite active complexity
profiles.reality_veto_relation: empirical dimensions remain reality-correctable; formal dimensions require fit-for-type validation

profiles.role: split, merge, retype, create, deprecate or re-coordinate ontology primitives with migration history
profiles.authority_boundary: may propose ontology mutation but cannot silently rewrite meaning/history
profiles.reality_veto_relation: ontology claims remain subject to evidence and falsification appropriate to scope

profiles.role: coordinate broad candidate-generation channels with selective validation, engineering/action and reality feedback without replacing science
profiles.authority_boundary: candidate origin never grants truth-status; science/formal methods remain fit-for-type verification subsystems
profiles.reality_veto_relation: empirical claims remain reality-facing and correctable

profiles.name_vi: Học thuyết Quyền Phủ quyết của Thực tại
profiles.authority_boundary: RVT formalizes Reality Veto but is itself subject to Reality Veto

profiles.name_vi: Nhận thức luận Đồng đẳng Thực thi Bách Lâm
profiles.authority_boundary: standing to submit does not imply equal belief, priority, resources or execution rights
profiles.reality_veto_relation: evidence and reality-facing correction constrain epistemic weight

profiles.role: public scholarly governance and technology interface
profiles.authority_boundary: open entry does not create truth by popularity

profiles.name_vi: Học thuyết Ưu thế Tri thức
profiles.role: knowledge rights, disclosure and knowledge-to-capability conversion
profiles.authority_boundary: strategic value cannot suppress adverse evidence
profiles.reality_veto_relation: knowledge state must track current evidence

profiles.name_vi: Học thuyết Trù tính Nguồn lực Tri thức Nhân loại
profiles.authority_boundary: routes distributed resources but does not own them or centralize truth authority

profiles.role: human agency, decision sovereignty, bounded AI and authorized execution
profiles.reality_veto_relation: actions produce outcomes; OHAS does not govern Reality

profiles.role: future-state regression, epistemic timing and capability preparation
profiles.provenance_or_source_state: public role integrated; full runtime source binding remains separate

profiles.authority_boundary: may challenge claims/dimensions/ontologies but cannot declare truth status
profiles.reality_veto_relation: adversarial findings prepare, not replace, qualified adjudication

integration_invariant: Public projections must not invent details absent from verified source; integration never silently replaces full doctrine sources, erases identity/history, converts a mode-dependent relation into a fixed hierarchy, or declares the current epistemic taxonomy exhaustive.
